help:
events list                               List the events providers on this page have declared  [read-only]
events recent [--since=<integer>]         Show recent events on this page, optionally only those after an event id  [read-only]
form node-article-form discard            Undo the unsaved changes in the new article form  [consequential]
form node-article-form fields             List the fields of the new article form with their type and current value  [read-only]
form node-article-form get <field>        Show one field's current value in the new article form, in full  [read-only]
form node-article-form save               Save the new article form, the same as clicking Save. The page reloads  [consequential]
form node-article-form set <field> <value>  Change a field in the new article form. Nothing is saved until form node-article-form save
form node-article-form status             Show the unsaved changes and the errors in the new article form  [read-only]
nav find <query>                          Find menu links whose title or description contains all the words  [read-only]
nav go <item>                             Go to a menu link, by path, title or breadcrumb, or to any path on this site  [navigates]
nav status                                Show where this page is in the menus  [read-only]
nav tree [menu] [--depth=<integer>]       Show a menu's links with their path and description  [read-only]
page status                               Show what this page is: its title, route and the entity it shows  [read-only]

formTools.name: form_node-article-form_discard
formTools.description: Undo the unsaved changes in the new article form. Returns { discarded: [string] }.

formTools.name: form_node-article-form_fields
formTools.description: List the fields of the new article form with their type and current value. Returns { fields: [{ field, label, type, required, value, options }] }.

formTools.name: form_node-article-form_get
formTools.description: Show one field's current value in the new article form, in full. Returns { field, value }.

field.description: A field of this form, such as body.summary, body.value, body.format. form node-article-form fields lists them all.

formTools.name: form_node-article-form_save
formTools.description: Save the new article form, the same as clicking Save. The page reloads. Leaves this page; the tools on the next page may differ. Returns { form, submitted }.

formTools.name: form_node-article-form_set
formTools.description: Change a field in the new article form. Nothing is saved until form node-article-form save. Returns { field, from, to }.

field.description: A field of this form, such as body.summary, body.value, body.format. form node-article-form fields lists them all.

value.description:
The new value. Yes/no fields take true or false, lists take a key or its label, tags take names separated by commas, HTML fields take HTML such as

…

formTools.name: form_node-article-form_status
formTools.description: Show the unsaved changes and the errors in the new article form. Returns { form, entity: { type, bundle, id, label }, unsaved: [{ field, from, to }], errors: [{ field, message }] }.
